Hey:  
Sorry for the delay in getting back to you. The more I reflect on it, the less promising it seems for either of us. There’s really no positive outcome, professionally or personally. I still consider you a good friend. That hasn’t changed, and I don’t think we need to act awkward around each other moving forward. We both wanted to explore it, and we did. Maybe it’s best to leave it at that.  
Jacques
